system.description:
You always gain [Cancel (Cold, Mob):20]. This is a crafting-level item made primarily from Yukihyou fur, combined with various magical materials. As one might imagine from the fluffy fur, it excels in insulation. Moreover, it possesses the ability to reduce external cold, allowing it to perform at an exceptional level in cold environments. Currently, in the Ezho region, it has begun to circulate in a variety of styles designed to adapt to different scenes.

Snow Leopard Pelt [Core Material] (340G) + Inverness (470G) + Earring of Cold (330G) + [Magic Catalyst 13] (170G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (690G)
